newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-UNIBANKA SLIDES AS BONUS SHARES ISSUED.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-UNIBANKA SLIDES AS BONUS SHARES ISSUED.

text.p: Unibanka slipped the maximum 15 percent allowed by the stock exchange on Monday as its bonus shares were issued, dealers said.
Unibanka lost 15 percent to 4.04 lats on the day's highest trade of 74,300 lats out of overall turnover of 161,000 lats.
"It should have fallen even further after the dividend and bonus shares," one trader said. He expected it to slipe lower tomorrow, hitting around 3.76 lats.
The bank has issued almost five million new shares as dividends.
The fall in Unibanka brought the Rietumu Bank index lower by 7.51 percent to 209.19.
Other shares were fairly quiet as only Daugavpils made any significant volumes on turnover of 30,200 lats for a slight gain of 0.4 percent or one santime to 2.79 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet, also on the official list, traded 13,700 lats and lost one santime to 1.76 lats.
Kaija traded 8,900 lats to rise two santimes to 2.43 lats
